name: Craft
tagline: Beautiful document editor for notes, docs, and wikis
painPoints: Primarily a document creation tool; no proactive AI or workflow automation
Paid Plus plan is needed for unlimited documents and advanced sharing
No email or calendar integration for automatic context capture
AI features focus on writing assistance inside documents, not cross-tool intelligence
Collaboration features require paid plans; free tier is restrictive
metaTitle: Craft Docs Alternative: AI That Builds Knowledge for You
metaDescription: Craft makes beautiful documents you write by hand. GAIA builds knowledge from your email and calendar and surfaces it when needed. Compare pricing, or use both.
whyPeopleLook: Craft earns rave reviews for its visual design, block-based editing, and smooth performance on Apple devices. It is a genuinely excellent document creation tool. But document creation is still a manual, time-consuming activity — you have to write everything, organize everything, and search for everything yourself. Craft's AI writing features help you write faster, but they do not connect to your email, calendar, or tasks to build context automatically. Users who want a tool that manages their knowledge proactively rather than requiring them to author it find Craft insufficient.
gaiaReplaces: Knowledge retrieval via semantic search without manual document organization
Meeting notes captured automatically from calendar events
Email correspondence context stored and retrievable by project
Task creation from document content without manual entry
gaiaAdvantages: Knowledge is built passively from email and calendar: no manual document creation
Proactive surfacing of relevant knowledge based on current work context
Source-available and self-hostable; Craft is closed-source SaaS
Full productivity assistant including email, tasks, and calendar
migrationSteps: Export Craft documents as Markdown or PDF
Import key documents into GAIA's memory system for semantic retrieval
Connect Gmail and Google Calendar to enrich GAIA's knowledge automatically
Use GAIA for day-to-day knowledge retrieval while keeping Craft for polished documents

faqs.question: Does GAIA have Craft's visual document editor?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not include a visual block-based document editor. Its strength is automatic knowledge capture and proactive retrieval via conversation. For creating polished documents and wikis, Craft remains a strong choice.

faqs.question: Is GAIA better than Craft for knowledge retrieval?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's semantic search and graph-based memory surface knowledge across email, calendar, tasks, and imported notes — providing much broader context than Craft's document search.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Craft?
faqs.answer: Craft's Plus plan is paid. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month but includes email management, calendar integration, tasks, and tool connections. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).

faqs.question: Can GAIA and Craft be used together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many users keep Craft for creating polished documents and use GAIA as the proactive AI layer that handles email triage, task management, and automatic knowledge capture from their broader workflow.

comparisonRows.gaia: Knowledge that accumulates passively from email and calendar, with an assistant that acts on it
comparisonRows.competitor: Beautiful block-based document and note-taking app with AI writing assistance, optimised for the Apple ecosystem with deep iOS and macOS integration

comparisonRows.gaia: Inbox becomes searchable project context automatically: threads stored, linked, and retrievable by project
comparisonRows.competitor: No native email integration: Craft does not read your inbox; content must be manually captured or shared into Craft documents

comparisonRows.gaia: Meeting notes captured from calendar events themselves, with briefings before and tasks after
comparisonRows.competitor: Tasks with due dates appear in iOS/macOS Calendar view; no Google Calendar management or proactive meeting preparation

comparisonRows.gaia: AI that drafts emails, schedules events, and creates tasks from knowledge, not an editor-scoped writing aid
comparisonRows.competitor: Built-in AI writing assistant for drafting, summarising, rewriting, and editing within the Craft document editor: reactive and editor-scoped

comparisonRows.gaia: Every platform including Android and Windows plus web and bots, beyond an Apple-optimized lineup
comparisonRows.competitor: Native apps for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS with a web app available; no native Android or Windows desktop application

comparisonRows.gaia: Tasks created from document content and email without manual entry, tracked with deadlines
comparisonRows.competitor: Built-in task system integrated with documents and calendar visibility; tasks created manually within the Craft editor

comparisonRows.gaia: Source-available and self-hostable, where Craft is closed-source SaaS
comparisonRows.competitor: Proprietary closed-source application; no self-hosting option; data stored on Craft's servers

comparisonRows.gaia: Deep integrations tie knowledge to the tools where work happens, wider than an export-and-API ecosystem
comparisonRows.competitor: Integrations with Slack, Jira, Linear, and export to Notion; API available; integration ecosystem narrower than productivity-focused platforms

comparisonRows.gaia: Relevant knowledge surfaced from current work context, not notifications about mentions and comments
comparisonRows.competitor: Passive tool: notifies of document mentions and comments; does not monitor external context or act proactively on your behalf

comparisonRows.gaia: Hosted: paid plan at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month; self-hosting free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs)
comparisonRows.competitor: Free plan and paid plans available; per-seat pricing; flat-rate option.
